court: Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit

issues.label: RLUIPA damages availability
issues.why: Court must determine whether RLUIPA permits monetary damages against officials in official or individual capacities.

issues.label: Eleventh Amendment immunity for official-capacity damages
issues.why: Sovereign immunity bars damages claims against state officials sued in their official capacities.

issues.label: Mootness of injunctive/declaratory relief
issues.why: VDOC's 2021 creation of a Ramadan-compliant OJKD may render prospective relief moot.

issues.label: Voluntary cessation exception to mootness
issues.why: Defendant-initiated policy changes may not moot claims if conduct could recur.

issues.label: RLUIPA substantial burden
issues.why: Whether forcing choice between OJKD and Ramadan fasting substantially burdened Roberts's exercise of religion.

issues.label: RLUIPA compelling interest and least restrictive means
issues.why: Whether food safety, planning, and administrative burdens justify the denial under strict scrutiny.

issues.label: Sincerity vs. reasonableness of religious belief
issues.why: Court must respect sincerity even where belief that Muslim faith requires Orthodox-Rabbi supervision seems unusual.

issues.label: Free Exercise clause standard for prisoners
issues.why: Turner reasonableness standard governs First Amendment free-exercise claims by inmates.

issues.label: Qualified immunity - clearly established law
issues.why: Whether the right to Rabbi-supervised kosher meals for Ramadan was clearly established for individual-capacity damages.

issues.label: Qualified immunity - constitutional violation prong
issues.why: Whether any constitutional violation occurred on Establishment and Equal Protection claims.

issues.label: Establishment Clause claim
issues.why: Whether VDOC's differing diet accommodations improperly favored or entangled with particular religions.

issues.label: Equal Protection claim
issues.why: Whether Roberts was treated differently from similarly situated Jewish inmates without justification.

issues.label: Personal involvement of each defendant
issues.why: Individual-capacity liability requires each defendant's personal participation in the alleged violation.

issues.label: Punitive damages availability
issues.why: Whether defendants' conduct meets the malice/reckless-indifference threshold for punitive damages.

issues.label: Substitution of parties
issues.why: Effect of substituting Walters for Clarke on official-capacity claims and Clarke's individual liability.

issues.label: Denial of motion to compel discovery
issues.why: Whether the magistrate erred in denying disclosure of Food Manual documents affecting the record.

issues.label: Pro se pleading liberal construction
issues.why: Court must liberally construe Roberts's pro se filings and claims.

issues.label: Summary judgment standard
issues.why: Evidence must be viewed favorably to Roberts as nonmovant with genuine disputes precluding judgment.

issues.label: Exhaustion of administrative remedies
issues.why: PLRA requires inmates to exhaust prison grievance procedures before suit.

issues.label: Physical injury requirement under PLRA
issues.why: PLRA may limit compensatory damages for mental/emotional injury absent physical harm, though food poisoning may satisfy this.

issues.label: Adequacy of alternative accommodations offered
issues.why: Whether the choice between OJKD-without-fasting or Common-Fare-with-fasting was a reasonable accommodation.

issues.label: Declaratory judgment on past conduct
issues.why: Whether declaratory relief regarding past violations remains available or is barred like injunctive relief.
